title: 第5章 保护费第6章 准备起诉给你们的最后机会
slug: 律师霸凌者无罪我送他死刑
content_zh:
同一时间，江海知名红圈所—君勇律师事务所。
这个律所是真正的红圈所。
总体胜诉率在93%！
年入上百万的律师有好几位。
年入40万，50万都是普遍现象，这里的实习律师都是各种顶级名校出来的，甚至都要交钱实习。
为的就是博得一个加入律所的机会。
此刻，君勇律师事务所非常热闹。
而且之前王大海请的王涛律师，就在这个律师任职。
“王律，林默接你班了，要是人家打贏了，你这金牌律师的名號算是栽嘍。”
王涛正在看案子，输了官司，他心情本来就不好，听到这话，眉头紧锁！
“你说谁接我班？！”
“林默啊，哈哈哈，咱们江海律政先锋啊！”
王涛心臟都抽动了一下，一股涌动的气血衝击著脑门，整个脸涨的通红！
再怎么说，自己也是红圈所的金牌律师，年纪轻轻就快要成为律所合伙人的律政精英，怎么能是林默这种乐色能够比的！
输了官司就算了，怎么能让林默替他！
这简直就是对他极致的侮辱！
“哼！他能打贏我特么叫他爸爸！”王涛怒吼道！
“好，王律，我录下来了，你可別后悔啊。”
顿时间，律所內传来了欢声笑语的声音。
网络上，还有几个法律大v也发表了看法。

罗大翔也发表了自己的看法。
他的角度很新奇，他视频中是这样说的。
“其实，林默律师只是眾多刚刚执业新人水平而已，之所以沦落到如今这个地步，確实是因为运气太差了，现在我看很多人都在质疑林默律师，別说，我还真期待他出奇制胜。”
评论下都以为罗大翔在搞笑。
高赞是：“林大律师別把王氏父子送进去就算贏。”
林默笑了一下，没有过多的在意。
【写到这里我希望读者记一下我们域名101??????.??????】
看了看时间，正好快要到放学时间了。
和王大海一起出门，打了个的士直奔江海市第五中学高中部。
先见见那三个小畜生再说。
很快林默就来到了第五中学初中部门口，好傢伙，还没到下课时间呢，校园外就围拢了一圈染著五顏六色毛的人。
长相稚嫩，身高不矮，175左右，身材很壮实。
他们的身前或多或少都停著三辆电动摩托，俗称鬼火。
这时候王大海指著被围在正中心的三个，咬牙切齿的说道：“那就是田英光，许志义，仇天磊三人！”
田英光染著一头黄髮，嘴里叼著烟，旁边还有小弟点菸。
许志义，仇天磊则是一个绿毛和蓝毛。
三人一个一台电动摩托。
这时候，三人开始大声且囂张高傲的说话：
“切，最近王乐乐都不来学校了，少了个乐子。”
content_en:
At the same time, Junyong Law Firm, a well-known red circle firm in Jianghai.
This law firm is a true red circle firm.
The overall winning rate is 93%!
There are several lawyers making millions a year.
It is common to earn between 400,000 and 500,000 yuan a year. The trainee lawyers here come from various top schools and even have to pay for internships.
The purpose is to win an opportunity to join a law firm.
At this moment, Junyong Law Firm is very busy.
Moreover, the lawyer Wang Tao hired by Wang Dahai was working at this lawyer.
"Wang Lu, Lin Mo takes over from you. If he wins, your reputation as a gold medal lawyer will be ruined."
Wang Tao was looking at the case. He lost the case. He was in a bad mood. When he heard this, he frowned!
"Who do you think will take over my class?!"
"Lin Mo, hahaha, we are the pioneers of Jianghai Law!"
Wang Tao's heart twitched, a surge of blood hit his forehead, and his whole face turned red!
After all, he is also a gold medal lawyer in a red circle firm and is about to become a partner of a law firm at a young age. How can a legal elite like Lin Mo be able to compare with him!
Even if he loses the lawsuit, how can he let Lin Mo take his place?
This is simply the ultimate insult to him!
"Hmph! If he can beat me, why don't I call him daddy!" Wang Tao roared!
"Okay, Wang Lu, I recorded it, don't regret it."
Suddenly, the sound of laughter and laughter came from the law firm.
On the Internet, several legal gurus also expressed their opinions.
Luo Daxiang also expressed his views.
His angle is novel, or so he says in the video.
"Actually, Lawyer Lin Mo is just a newcomer to the profession. The reason why he has fallen to this point is indeed because of bad luck. Now I see that many people are questioning Lawyer Lin Mo. Needless to say, I really expect him to succeed by surprise."
Everyone in the comments thought Luo Daxiang was joking.
High praise: "Lawyer Lin, don't count the Wangs and his sons as winners by sending them in."
Lin Mo smiled and didn't care too much.

I looked at the time and saw that it was almost time for school to end.
He went out with Wang Dahai, took a taxi and went straight to the high school of Jianghai City No. 5 Middle School.
Let’s meet those three little beasts first.
Soon Lin Mo arrived at the entrance of the junior high school of No. 5 Middle School. My dear, before get out of class ended, there was a circle of people with colorful hair gathered outside the campus.
He looks young, not short, about 175cm tall, and has a strong build.
There are three electric motorcycles parked more or less in front of them, commonly known as ghost fires.
At this time, Wang Dahai pointed to the three people surrounded in the center and said through gritted teeth: "That's Tian Yingguang, Xu Zhiyi, and Qiu Tianlei!"
Tian Yingguang had yellow hair and a cigarette in his mouth, and his younger brother was lighting a cigarette next to him.
Xu Zhiyi and Qiu Tianlei are green and blue.
Three people each have an electric motorcycle.
At this time, the three people began to speak loudly and arrogantly:
"Tch, Wang Lele doesn't come to school recently, so there's less fun."
